boxnow.name: BOX NOW
boxnow.description: BOX NOW parcel-locker delivery in Greece, Cyprus, Bulgaria, Croatia and Slovenia, with cash on delivery and the full locker list.

fields.name: environment
fields.label: Environment
fields.instructions: Sandbox uses BOX NOW’s stage host. Stage parcels are never collected.

fields.name: country
fields.label: Country
fields.instructions: BOX NOW issues credentials per country and delivers only within it. Slovenia uses the Croatian host unless BOX NOW gave you another URL.

fields.name: clientSecret
fields.label: Client secret
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.name: originLocationId
fields.label: Origin (warehouse) ID
fields.instructions: The id BOX NOW registered for your warehouse — the connection test lists them. Use “any-apm” if you drop parcels into any locker yourself.

fields.name: partnerId
fields.label: Partner ID
fields.instructions: Only when one login manages several partners. Sent as X-PartnerID.

fields.name: apiUrl
fields.label: API URL
fields.instructions: Leave blank to use the standard host for the country and environment. Fill it in if BOX NOW gave you a different one.

options.auto: Smallest that fits the parcel’s dimensions

fields.name: allowReturn
fields.label: Allow the customer to return through BOX NOW

mock.name: Mock Carrier
mock.description: A pretend carrier for setting up and testing checkout, labels and tracking without a real account.

fields.name: environment
fields.label: Environment
fields.instructions: Sandbox labels are not valid for shipping. Most carriers issue separate credentials for each.

fields.name: accountNumber
fields.label: Account number
fields.instructions: Anything. Printed on the label so you can tell sandboxes apart.

fields.name: apiKey
fields.label: API key
fields.instructions: Anything at least six characters long. Never printed, never logged.

options.timeout: Time out after sending (the label may exist)
options.down: Be down for rates, tracking and points

fields.name: stageSeconds
fields.label: Seconds per tracking stage
fields.instructions: How quickly a mock parcel moves from label to delivered.

fields.name: webhookSecret
fields.label: Webhook signing secret
fields.instructions: Pushes to the webhook URL must carry an X-Mock-Signature HMAC-SHA256 of the body.

store-pickup.name: Pick up in store
store-pickup.description: Customers collect from one of your Commerce inventory locations. Prints a collection slip instead of a label.

fields.name: locationHandles
fields.label: Locations
fields.instructions: Comma-separated inventory location handles customers may collect from. Leave blank for every location with an address.

fields.name: hours
fields.label: Opening hours
fields.instructions: Shown in the picker, e.g. “Mon–Sat 9:00–18:00”.

dpd-easyship.name: DPD EasyShip
dpd-easyship.description: DPD Croatia and DPD Slovenia through their EasyShip portal (easyship.hr / easyship.si, not Easyship.com): labels, cash on delivery, parcel shops, tracking, collections and the daily manifest.

fields.name: country
fields.label: EasyShip country
fields.instructions: Where your DPD contract is. EasyShip is DPD’s own portal, not Easyship.com.

fields.name: username
fields.label: EasyShip username
fields.instructions: The login you use at easyship.hr or easyship.si. DPD issues no separate API key, and has no test system.

fields.name: password
fields.label: EasyShip password
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.name: codSplit
fields.label: Cash on delivery across several parcels
fields.instructions: EasyShip’s parcel_cod_type. Only matters when one COD shipment has more than one parcel.

fields.name: sendSender
fields.label: Print the ship-from address on labels
fields.instructions: Off: labels show the sender saved in your EasyShip profile.

fedex.name: FedEx
fedex.description: FedEx rates, PDF, PNG and ZPL labels, returns, tracking, Hold at Location, pickups and address validation through the FedEx REST APIs.

fields.name: environment
fields.label: Environment
fields.instructions: FedEx issues separate keys for its sandbox (apis-sandbox.fedex.com). Sandbox rates are not real and its labels are not valid.

fields.label: FedEx project
fields.instructions: Create a project at developer.fedex.com with the Ship, Rate, Track, Address Validation, Locations and Pickup APIs, and link your FedEx account to it.

fields.name: clientId
fields.label: API key
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.name: clientSecret
fields.label: Secret key
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.name: accountNumber
fields.label: FedEx account number
fields.instructions: The nine-digit account labels are billed to.

fields.name: pickupType
fields.label: How parcels reach FedEx

options.CONTACT_FEDEX_TO_SCHEDULE: I book a pickup when I need one

fields.instructions: FedEx prices some services differently depending on this.

fields.name: pickupCarrier
fields.label: Pickups are for
fields.instructions: FedEx books Express and Ground collections separately. Book the other one in FedEx Ship Manager.

fields.name: declareValue
fields.label: Declare each parcel’s value
fields.instructions: Raises FedEx’s liability above the included $100. FedEx charges for it.

freight-tforce.name: TForce Freight
freight-tforce.description: LTL quotes, bills of lading with PDF or ZPL labels, pickups and PRO tracking from TForce Freight.

fields.name: environment
fields.label: Environment
fields.instructions: Sandbox uses TForce’s Customer Integration Environment (same host, api-version cie-v1). CIE rates are not your contract rates.

fields.name: clientId
fields.label: Client ID
fields.instructions: developer.tforcefreight.com → Profile → Configure My Client.

fields.name: clientSecret
fields.label: Client secret
fields.instructions: Shown only once when the client is created. Store it in an environment variable.

fields.name: defaultFreightClass
fields.label: Default freight class

options: None — every handling unit must carry its own class

fields.instructions: Used for any handling unit that arrives without a freight class. Leave as None to refuse such shipments rather than guess.

fields.name: commodityDescription
fields.label: Commodity description
fields.instructions: Printed on the bill of lading when a handling unit has no description of its own.

freight-odfl.name: Old Dominion
freight-odfl.description: LTL quotes, NMFTA electronic bills of lading, pickups and PRO tracking from Old Dominion Freight Line.

fields.name: environment
fields.label: Environment
fields.instructions: Sandbox uses ODFL’s QA host (apiq.odfl.com). Ask API@odfl.com for QA access.

fields.name: password
fields.label: ODFL.com password
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.name: accountNumber
fields.label: ODFL account number
fields.instructions: Your bill-to account, for contract pricing. Digits only.

fields.name: defaultFreightClass
fields.label: Default freight class

options: None — every handling unit must carry its own class

fields.instructions: Used for any handling unit that arrives without a freight class. Leave as None to refuse such shipments rather than guess.

fields.name: commodityDescription
fields.label: Commodity description
fields.instructions: Printed on the bill of lading when a handling unit has no description of its own.

freight-estes.name: Estes Express
freight-estes.description: LTL quotes, NMFTA electronic bills of lading with labels, and PRO tracking from Estes Express Lines.

fields.name: environment
fields.label: Environment
fields.instructions: Sandbox uses uat-cloudapi.estes-express.com. Estes issues separate credentials and API keys for each environment.

fields.name: apiKey
fields.label: API key
fields.instructions: Created once per environment with POST /v1/api-key using the client ID and secret Estes emailed you (WebSupport@estes-express.com). That call replaces the emailed secret.

fields.name: password
fields.label: MyEstes password
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.name: accountNumber
fields.label: Estes account number
fields.instructions: Your shipper account, for contract pricing.

fields.name: defaultFreightClass
fields.label: Default freight class

options: None — every handling unit must carry its own class

fields.instructions: Used for any handling unit that arrives without a freight class. Leave as None to refuse such shipments rather than guess.

fields.name: commodityDescription
fields.label: Commodity description
fields.instructions: Printed on the bill of lading when a handling unit has no description of its own.

freight-xpo.name: XPO
freight-xpo.description: LTL quotes, bills of lading with shipping labels, voids and PRO tracking from XPO.

fields.name: consumerKey
fields.label: Consumer key
fields.instructions: Email LTLWebAPISupport@xpo.com from your registered XPO web user to subscribe.

fields.name: consumerSecret
fields.label: Consumer secret
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.name: password
fields.label: XPO LTL web password
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.name: accountNumber
fields.label: XPO account (acctInstId)
fields.instructions: Your shipper account instance id, for contract pricing.

fields.name: testMode
fields.label: Test mode
fields.instructions: XPO has no sandbox. Test mode sends testMode=Y on bills of lading; rating and tracking always use production.

fields.name: defaultFreightClass
fields.label: Default freight class

options: None — every handling unit must carry its own class

fields.instructions: Used for any handling unit that arrives without a freight class. Leave as None to refuse such shipments rather than guess.

fields.name: commodityDescription
fields.label: Commodity description
fields.instructions: Printed on the bill of lading when a handling unit has no description of its own.

freight-rl.name: R+L Carriers
freight-rl.description: LTL quotes, NMFTA electronic bills of lading with labels, and PRO tracking from R+L Carriers.

fields.name: apiKey
fields.label: API key
fields.instructions: rlcarriers.com → Resources → API Overview → Access API Key. R+L has no test environment: every bill of lading is real.

fields.name: defaultFreightClass
fields.label: Default freight class

options: None — every handling unit must carry its own class

fields.instructions: Used for any handling unit that arrives without a freight class. Leave as None to refuse such shipments rather than guess.

fields.name: commodityDescription
fields.label: Commodity description
fields.instructions: Printed on the bill of lading when a handling unit has no description of its own.

freight-saia.name: SAIA
freight-saia.description: LTL quotes, NMFTA electronic bills of lading with labels, and PRO tracking from SAIA. Rating and tracking responses are unverified.

fields.name: environment
fields.label: Environment
fields.instructions: Sandbox uses SAIA’s pilot gateway (saiapilotapi.azure-api.net), which has its own subscription keys.

fields.label: Saia Secure login
fields.instructions: Your saiasecure.com account. Sent in the body of rate requests and as Basic auth for tracking.

fields.name: password
fields.label: Saia Secure password
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.label: Subscription keys
fields.instructions: One per product, from the developer portal: Products → subscribe → primary key.

fields.name: rateQuoteKey
fields.label: Rate Quote key (RQ-Key)
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.name: trackingKey
fields.label: Customer Tracking REST key (Tracking-Key)
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.name: bolKey
fields.label: Bill of Lading key (Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key)
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.name: defaultFreightClass
fields.label: Default freight class

options: None — every handling unit must carry its own class

fields.instructions: Used for any handling unit that arrives without a freight class. Leave as None to refuse such shipments rather than guess.

fields.name: commodityDescription
fields.label: Commodity description
fields.instructions: Printed on the bill of lading when a handling unit has no description of its own.

gls.name: GLS
gls.description: GLS through MyGLS in Croatia, Hungary, Czechia, Romania, Slovenia, Slovakia and Serbia: labels, cash on delivery, parcel shops and lockers, tracking.

fields.name: country
fields.label: MyGLS country
fields.instructions: The GLS country your contract is with. Each country runs its own MyGLS, with its own logins.

fields.name: environment
fields.label: Environment
fields.instructions: The MyGLS test system (api.test.mygls.…) needs separate test credentials from your local GLS office.

fields.name: username
fields.label: MyGLS username
fields.instructions: The email address you sign in to MyGLS with.

fields.name: password
fields.label: MyGLS password
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.name: clientNumber
fields.label: Client number
fields.instructions: Your GLS client number, from the contract. It goes on every parcel.

posta-hr.name: Hrvatska pošta
posta-hr.description: Croatia’s national post: Paket 24 to the door, a post office or a Paketomat, with cash on delivery.

26-PU.name: Paket 24 D+1 to a post office

fields.name: environment
fields.label: Environment
fields.instructions: Test uses dxwebapit.posta.hr. Hrvatska pošta issues separate credentials for each environment.

fields.name: username
fields.label: Username
fields.instructions: The API username from your Hrvatska pošta contract manager.

fields.name: password
fields.label: Password
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.label: Hand-over
fields.instructions: How parcels reach Hrvatska pošta. Your server must be able to reach ports 9000 and 9020 on posta.hr; many shared hosts block them.

fields.name: senderPickupCenter
fields.label: Hand-over post office or Paketomat code
fields.instructions: Required when parcels are handed over at a post office or Paketomat.

fields.name: defaultLockerSize
fields.label: Paketomat compartment for parcels without dimensions
fields.instructions: Parcels with dimensions get the smallest compartment they fit.

posta-si.name: Pošta Slovenije
posta-si.description: Slovenia’s national post: tracking for parcels you send with Pošta Slovenije’s own tools. Labels are not available through an API.

fields.label: Tracking API
fields.instructions: Three values from your Pošta Slovenije contract manager for the tracking API (eSledenje). They are separate from your eSpremnica credentials.

fields.name: trackingUser
fields.label: Tracking user
fields.instructions: A GUID. Store it in an environment variable.

fields.name: trackingPassword
fields.label: Tracking password
fields.instructions: A GUID. Store it in an environment variable.

fields.name: trackingUserToken
fields.label: User token
fields.instructions: The long user token Pošta Slovenije issued, exactly as given, without quotes.

fields.name: usePointFeed
fields.label: Use the unofficial posta.si point finder
fields.instructions: Pošta Slovenije has no public pickup-point API. This uses the JSON behind the office finder on posta.si, which is not a supported interface and may change without notice. Leave it off unless you offer Paketomat delivery and accept that risk.

posta-hu.name: Magyar Posta (MPL)
posta-hu.description: Hungary’s national post: MPL Business and Postal Parcels to the door, a post office, PostaPont or a parcel terminal, with cash on delivery.

A_175_UZL-CS.name: MPL Business Parcel to a parcel terminal

A_175_UZL-PP.name: MPL Business Parcel to a PostaPont

A_175_UZL-PM.name: MPL Business Parcel to a post office

A_177_MPC-PM.name: MPL Postal Parcel to a post office

fields.name: environment
fields.label: Environment
fields.instructions: The sandbox is a mock service with weaker validation. Each environment has its own key and secret (devportal → Applications).

fields.name: clientId
fields.label: API key
fields.instructions: The consumer key of your devportal application.

fields.name: clientSecret
fields.label: API secret
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.name: accountingCode
fields.label: Customer code
fields.instructions: Sent as X-Accounting-Code on every request. It maps one-to-one to the API key.

fields.name: agreementCode
fields.label: Agreement code
fields.instructions: The contract (agreement) the parcels are posted under, printed on your MPL contract.

fields.name: bankAccount
fields.label: Bank account for COD
fields.instructions: Where MPL pays collected cash on delivery, e.g. 11112222-33334444-00000000.

fields.name: webshopId
fields.label: Webshop id
fields.instructions: Any short id; MPL echoes it back so one account can serve several shops.

elta.name: ELTA Courier
elta.description: Greece’s postal courier: vouchers with cash on delivery and tracking, through ELTA Courier’s contract web services.

fields.label: Web services account
fields.instructions: From your ELTA Courier contract (ask your branch, +30 210 607 3000 or info@elta-courier.gr). The service uses plain HTTP: these values cross the internet unencrypted.

fields.name: userCode
fields.label: User code
fields.instructions: Digits only. The test account is 9999999.

fields.name: password
fields.label: Password
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.name: customerCode
fields.label: Customer (sender) code
fields.instructions: Your ELTA Courier customer code. The test account is 999999999.

fields.name: customerSubCode
fields.label: Customer sub-code
fields.instructions: Only if ELTA Courier gave you one for this dispatch point.

fields.name: serviceCode
fields.label: Service code
fields.instructions: The pel_service value from your contract. 1 is the standard service.

fields.label: Endpoint
fields.instructions: Change these only if your contract WSDL names a different address.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.label: Endpoint
fields.instructions: Your host must allow outbound connections to port 9003.

ups.name: UPS
ups.description: UPS rates, ZPL and PNG labels, returns, tracking, Access Points, pickups and address validation through the UPS REST APIs.

fields.name: environment
fields.label: Environment
fields.instructions: Sandbox uses UPS’s Customer Integration Environment (wwwcie.ups.com). Its labels are not valid for shipping.

fields.label: UPS app
fields.instructions: Create an app at developer.ups.com, add the Authorization, Rating, Shipping, Tracking, Locator, Pickup and Address Validation products, and link your UPS account to it.

fields.name: clientId
fields.label: Client ID
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.name: clientSecret
fields.label: Client secret
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.name: accountNumber
fields.label: UPS account number
fields.instructions: The six-character shipper number labels are billed to. It also unlocks negotiated rates.

fields.name: negotiatedRates
fields.label: Use negotiated rates
fields.instructions: Ask UPS for your account’s contract rates. Accounts without them get published rates.

fields.name: declareValue
fields.label: Declare each parcel’s value
fields.instructions: Buys UPS declared-value coverage above the included $100. UPS charges for it.

usps.name: USPS
usps.description: USPS prices, domestic and international labels, tracking, carrier pickups and Post Office locations, on the USPS APIs v3.

USPS_GROUND_ADVANTAGE_HFP.name: USPS Ground Advantage, Hold for Pickup

PRIORITY_MAIL_EXPRESS_HFP.name: Priority Mail Express, Hold for Pickup

fields.name: environment
fields.label: Environment
fields.instructions: Sandbox uses USPS’s Testing Environment for Mailers (TEM). TEM labels are watermarked and not billed.

fields.name: clientId
fields.label: Consumer Key
fields.instructions: From your app on the USPS developer portal.

fields.name: clientSecret
fields.label: Consumer Secret
fields.instructions: Store this in an environment variable rather than in the database.

fields.label: Label payment
fields.instructions: Labels are paid from an EPS (or permit) account linked in the USPS Business Customer Gateway. Rates, tracking and address checks work without these.

fields.name: crid
fields.label: CRID
fields.instructions: Customer Registration ID, from the Business Customer Gateway.

fields.name: mid
fields.label: MID
fields.instructions: Mailer ID used for labels.

fields.name: manifestMid
fields.label: Manifest MID
fields.instructions: Leave blank to use the MID above.

fields.name: accountNumber
fields.label: Payment account number
fields.instructions: The EPS account number, or the permit number.

fields.name: permitZip
fields.label: Permit ZIP Code
fields.instructions: Only for a permit account.
